title: AccountIdentitySetPayload

accountId.description: An account's id on its environment: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it adopts or adds the account; an account carried over from configuration keeps the id it was configured with.

provider.description: A provider's id, as the environment's adapter registry keys it: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (claude).

email.description: The login's email, as the provider's status reports it.

organisation.description: The organisation the login belongs to, when the provider reports one.

identity.description: Who an account signed in as: the provider, the email and the organisation when present; one account per identity per environment.

description: account.identity-set: a status read said who the account is signed in as, and it was not what the store held.
